# Columns: method  arm  problems(':'-list | all)  bundle  wall(D-HH:MM:SS)  mem_GB  throttle  tag
# Derivation (T01 log §3.8; scratch estimate.py):
#  * UDFS: never meets stop_thresh on noisy data, so every cell runs its full
#    12 h (C2: 100 % of UDFS cells on the 1000-row suites ran 12.00 h).  B = 1, wall 16 h
#    = C2 MIN_WALL_H.  Each task > 12 h, which clears the SCBI 2 h floor.
#  * Bingo stops at max_evals = 1e8 (or 12 h).  Per-dataset duration = 1e8 / eval rate.
#    The rate comes from a 30 s local probe per dataset, calibrated by
#    k = C2 Picasso median / local estimate on I.15.10 and R1:
#    k_baseline = 3.38, k_dedup = 2.91 (the max of the two problems).  The dedup arms add a
#    measured wrapper overhead per Bingo evaluation: 29.8 us (hash), 42.4 us (isalsr).
#    Estimated cells: baseline 1.0-11.4 h (12 datasets < 2 h), hash 3.3-12 h, isalsr 4.3-12 h.
#  * Bingo baseline, the 12 datasets estimated < 2 h: B = 3, i.e. 3.1-5.9 h per task.
#    Wall from C2's wall_hours(B=3, cell_h=1.95) = max(16, ceil(min(3*12.5, 1.4*3*1.95 + 12.5))) = 21 h.
#    Deadline cutoff 21 - 12.5 = 8.5 h.  A misestimate cannot cause a TIMEOUT: a cell
#    starts only if its full 12 h + 0.5 h fits, and any deferred cell is run by the sweep array.
#  * Everything else: B = 1, wall 16 h.
#  * Memory as C2 (c2_slot_plan.MEM_GB): UDFS 16 GB, Bingo 32 GB.
#  * Throttle = the array's task count, so no throttle: 1,120 tasks at most, against C2's
#    2,016 slots.  Peak memory 600*16 + 520*32 GB = 26.2 TB, inside the 50 TB per-user QOS.
# Totals: 1,200 cells, 1,120 tasks, 7 arrays (+1 sweep array for the B = 3 row).
